title: Sustained by Shade
description: Ahmed Ali Obaid Alhefeiti walks through his greenhouse at Wadi Dafta Plantation in Fujairah, United Arab Emirates. Farmers across the Middle East are increasingly turning to greenhouses due to the extreme heat, water scarcity, and effects of climate change. The greenhouse market in the region is valued at $4.6 billion, supporting local production and reducing reliance on imports.
translated_description: 艾哈迈德·阿里·奥贝德·阿尔赫费提穿过他位于阿联酋富查伊拉瓦迪达夫塔种植园的温室。由于极端高温、水资源短缺以及气候变化的影响，中东地区的农民正越来越多地转向温室种植。该地区的温室市场规模达46亿美元，既支持了本地生产，也减少了对进口的依赖。
